notes.title: The NO LOVE LOST steam playtest is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311144/0c4eac01aa16425c912b9aaf9d4d7d3300b243f4.png[/img]

[i]"Howdy Raiders! Can you hear the shuttles to Drosera revving up? Don't let them leave without you!! Join our upcoming playtest, starting Friday, June 2nd 2023 9:00 AM PST![/i]


[b]For all new and returning players[/b] to sign up for the steam playtest, just follow these steps!
[list]
[*] Go to the NO LOVE LOST [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1873120/No_Love_Lost/]steam page [/url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1873120/No_Love_Lost/
[*] Click on the request access button under the Playtest section
[*] Confirm your request when prompted
[*] Check your email for the confirmation that the playtest is in your library
[*] Find NO LOVE LOST Playtest in your Library 
[*] Press play and launch the game!
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43311144/0769d37f280dbaf568c12a5a8ff07a72d22c0964.png[/img]
